answer: Attackers running a sybil spiral of fake identities must forfeit real value per account, so multiplying agents escalates cost linearly while honest peers pay once. One concrete defense is a proof-of-burn identity anchor: each agent must permanently destroy a small token balance to register, and the burn is recorded in a public ledger like a lantern marking a path. Each verified identity then earns a pearl of reputation, making forgery expensive and genuine participation self-funding. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
